exact_contracts: A fixed finite table of actual sources, targets and roles defines the role-qualified index subtype and actual typed quiver arrows. Its complete edge tags are equivalent to the selected IDs, with proved inverse laws. Vertex(table,role) is a lossless one-field wrapper binding the actual quiver instance; vertexEquiv proves equivalence with V, no new path datatype.

The actual fixed-root path codec preserves every qualified ID occurrence in chronological order, including parallel edges and repetitions, with root/join/end evidence. Empty traces retain their outer root.

Actual bounds-and-role-checked Nat→Option RoleId lookup, actual full-row ID projection inverse and compact_preserves_ids consume actual prefix-state compaction. Decidable role equality for lookup and full-tag equality for compaction; path/ID equivalence needs neither finite V nor decidable vertex equality.
accepted_controls: Actual Fin4 Bool fixture: IDs0,1:A→B roleR;2:B→A roleR;3:B→A roleS. [0] and[1] same endpoint/length but actual paths distinct; [0,2,1] revisiting and[0,2,0] repeated-ID paths decode exactly, with count(id0)=2 and repeated-history distinction.
Actual [0,1] brokenjoin, wrongroot/wrongend, role3 lookupnone and outofbounds4 lookupnone. Actual mapM natural-ID lists accept [0,2,0], reject [0,3]/[0,4]; empty decoded roots remain distinct.

Actual stored one-step rows with repeated key11 and histories[0],[0,2,1],[0] compact with same qualified-ID rows/root, and full recovered occurrences equal original storedRows. Sole negative uses actual roletrue evidence as rolefalse witness; mathematical parallel fixture does not change operational duplicate-edge guard.
